	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999
	potential = { scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_court_positions_initialized } }

		looking_for_a = character

		target_flag = target

			is_general = no
			is_admiral = no
			is_explorer = no
			is_loyal = yes
			NOT = { has_character_modifier = busy_modifier }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			scope:actor = { hidden_effect = { tv_court_positions_appoint_physician_effect = yes } }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_court_physician_select_action_1 = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999
	potential = { scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_court_positions_initialized } }
	allow = { scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_court_physician_character var:tv_court_physician_character ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = location
		source = actor
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = { every_owned_location = { add_to_list = source } }
		}
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_court_select_physician_disease_control_location"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_court_no_physician_disease_control_location_available"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = { owner ?= scope:actor }
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			scope:actor = {
				var:tv_court_physician_location ?= { remove_location_modifier = tv_court_physician_disease_control_modifier }
				set_variable = { name = tv_court_physician_location value = scope:target }
				set_variable = { name = tv_court_physician_action value = 1 }
				tv_court_positions_refresh_physician_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			scope:actor = { hidden_effect = { tv_court_positions_appoint_cultural_emissary_effect = yes } }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_court_appoint_chronicler = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999
	potential = { scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_court_positions_initialized } }
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_court_chronicler_character }
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_court_select_chronicler"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_court_no_chronicler_available"
		column = { data = character_info }
		visible = {
			is_alive = yes
			is_adult = yes
			is_artist = no
			is_ruler = no
			is_heir = no
			is_consort = no
			in_cabinet = no
			is_general = no
			is_admiral = no
			is_explorer = no
			is_loyal = yes
			NOT = { has_character_modifier = busy_modifier }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			scope:actor = { hidden_effect = { tv_court_positions_appoint_chronicler_effect = yes } }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}
